title: 開口流路と3枚の吸音隔壁を持つダクト消音器
titleEn: Open duct silencer with three acoustic splitters
description: 機械室や空調ダクトの直線区間に置く矩形消音器の静的プロップ。前後に貫通する開口筐体、接続フランジ、丸い前後端を持つ3枚の縦長吸音隔壁と4本の流路、濃色の側面パネルと内張り、外部補強継ぎ目、側面点検蓋、下面の支持レールを造形しています。空箱ではなく内部の隔壁を含む構成ですが、材質は不透明な単色外観用で、吸音材の微細孔や繊維は表現していません。接続ダクト、音響減衰、周波数特性、圧力損失、実際の空気流、断熱・防火性能や法規適合は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.155 × 0.950 × 1.542 m、9,932三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static rectangular duct-silencer prop for a straight ventilation run or plant room, with an open-through casing and connecting flanges, three full-height longitudinal acoustic splitters with rounded leading and trailing noses forming four passages, dark side panels and liners, external stiffening seams, a side access cover and lower mounting rails. It includes genuine internal splitter geometry rather than an empty box, but its opaque constant-color materials are appearance-only, with no microscopic pores or fibers modeled. Connecting ducts, acoustic attenuation, frequency response, pressure loss, actual airflow, insulation/fire performance and regulatory compliance are omitted. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.155 × 0.950 × 1.542 m; 9,932 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
